title: 第946章 妖兽齐来楚峰出手第945章 强者聚熔岩朱果争夺战开始
lines: 熔岩空间中，战斗还在继续。
然而，他们不知道的是，朱果成熟的香味早已经扩散到了外面。
不少的强大妖兽闻着香味便朝着这边赶来。
天空中，一头庞大的老鹰妖兽急速划破空间，直奔熔岩空间而来。
同时，楚峰所在的通道中，香味也顺着通道飘散到了外面。
那位本来就在追踪楚峰踪迹的八级火兽，此刻已然追到了洼地附近。
当朱果香味飘了过来之后，它顿时双眼一亮，整个身体猛然一震。
“这是顶尖灵药成熟的香味，哈哈哈，这些人类果然是无利不起早，这灵药是本王的了！”
它大笑一声，从草丛中冲出，进入洼地，一眼就瞥见了那开了口子的通道。
随即，它的身体迅速变小，钻进了通道之中，顺着通道，急速的冲向香味飘来的方向。
通道出口处，楚峰隐身看着下方的战斗，摇了摇头。
“啧啧，想要得到朱果，果然没有那么简单啊！”
想要摘取朱果，就必须突破三处战场，除非他将血神交出来，否则连靠近都无法做到。
而就在这时，血神的声音忽然在他的脑海中响起。
“小子，别看了！赶紧出去，找个地方隐藏起来！
那一头八级火兽跟了进来，正在急速朝这边赶来！”
楚峰脸色一变，转身看向身后的方向。
那里的确有着一股强大的炙热气息正在急速靠近。
奈何通道不大，无处可藏，他只能从通道出口跳下，朝着下方一个角落落去。
整个过程，他都保持隐身状态，收敛气息。
此刻，所有人的注意力都放在了朱果树上，根本无法察觉到他。
几息后，他轻轻的落在了不大的熔岩壳上，随即继续隐身，收敛气息躲在一块凸起的石头后面。
几乎是他刚藏好的瞬间，一道火红色的身影从通道之中冲了出去。
它的双眼瞬间就被那一棵十丈高的朱果树给吸引住了。
“哈哈哈，原来是熔岩朱果，太好了，有了此物，本王便能进一步蜕变！”
大笑一声，他化作一道流光直奔朱果树而去。
正在战斗的几人脸色猛然大变。
若是他们不及时出手拦住火兽，这三枚朱果，恐怕会落在这一头火兽手中。
“一头孽畜，也想要染指朱果，滚开！”
几位道台境强者也顾不得相互战斗，同时朝着那急速冲向朱果树的火兽打出攻击。
火兽的脸色猛然大变，六道道台境强者的联手攻击，即便是它，也不得不暂避锋芒。
它身形一闪，险之又险的躲过了攻击。
但它也失去了靠近朱果树的机会。
content_en:
In the lava space, the battle continues.
However, what they didn't know was that the scent of ripe red fruits had already spread outside.
Many powerful monsters came towards this direction after smelling the scent.
In the sky, a huge eagle monster quickly cut through the space and headed straight for the lava space.
At the same time, in the passage where Chu Feng was, the fragrance also spread out along the passage.
The eighth-level fire beast that had been tracking Chu Feng had now reached the vicinity of the depression.
When the fragrance of red fruit wafted over, its eyes suddenly lit up and its whole body shook suddenly.
"This is the mature fragrance of the top elixir. Hahaha, these humans are really useless. This elixir belongs to me!"
It laughed, rushed out of the grass, entered the depression, and caught a glimpse of the opened passage.
Immediately, its body quickly became smaller and it got into the passage. Along the passage, it quickly rushed towards the direction where the fragrance was coming from.
At the exit of the passage, Chu Feng looked invisible at the battle below and shook his head.
"Tsk, tsk, it's really not that simple to get Zhu Guo!"
If he wants to pick the red fruit, he must break through three battlefields. Unless he hands over the Blood God, he can't even get close.
At this moment, the Blood God's voice suddenly sounded in his mind.
"Boy, stop looking! Get out quickly and find a place to hide!
The eighth-level fire beast followed and was rushing here! "
Chu Feng's expression changed and he turned to look in the direction behind him.
There is indeed a powerful hot breath approaching rapidly.
However, the passage was not big and there was nowhere to hide. He could only jump down from the exit of the passage and fall towards a corner below.
Throughout the process, he remained invisible and controlled his aura.
At this moment, everyone's attention was focused on the red fruit tree and they were unable to notice him at all.
After a few breaths, he landed lightly on a small lava shell, and then continued to become invisible, gathering his breath and hiding behind a raised stone.
Almost as soon as he hid it, a fiery red figure rushed out from the passage.
Its eyes were instantly attracted by the ten-foot-tall red fruit tree.
"Hahaha, it turns out to be a lava vermilion fruit. That's great. With this thing, I can further transform!"
With a loud laugh, he turned into a stream of light and went straight to the red fruit tree.
The faces of the people fighting suddenly changed.
If they didn't stop the fire beast in time, these three red fruits might fall into the hands of the fire beast.
"You are an evil beast who wants to get his hands on the red fruit, so get away!"
Several Taoist realm experts did not care about fighting each other, and simultaneously attacked the fire beast that rushed towards the Zhuguoshu.
The fire beast's expression suddenly changed, and even it had to avoid the sharp edge temporarily due to the joint attack of the six-path Taoist realm powerhouses.
It dodged, narrowly escaping the attack.
But it also lost the opportunity to get close to the red fruit tree.
title_en: Chapter 946 Monsters come together and Chu Feng takes action Chapter 945 The battle for the strong men to gather lava and red fruits begins
